description: Retrieve one community by its directory id, including its join link, platform, region, topic and member count where one was given. Call this to answer a specific question about one group, or after search_communities when a shortlist needs the join links filled in. Do not call it to discover communities: it takes an id and nothing else. Search first. An unknown id returns not-found rather than a guess.
name: get_community
title: Get a community
